$schema: see scripts/site-assets.mjs: every field is documented there
$comment: The site's pictures, declared. `node scripts/site-assets.mjs` takes every one
of them from the running product against a fixture population, on the pinned
demo clock, and writes them to docs/media/site/.
A crop rectangle is in CSS pixels of the 1600x1000 stage, measured from the
top left of the page. `width` is the width of the `@2x` file; the plain file
beside it is half that, and the two are what a page's `srcset` names. A GIF
is one file at `width`, with its first frame beside it as a still.
Nothing here is a mockup. An asset a fixture cannot reach is reported by the
run and left out of the site; it is never staged by hand.
